Mod.Name: Cronos DEMO
Mod.Author: Cronos Team
Mod.Description:
► The most ambitious gameplay mod! ◄
This mod aims to set a new standard for gameplay enhancements. It introduces many innovative ideas, below is a list of some of the changes:
◆ General options: ◄ • Language: currently, only English is supported. • Monsters Difficulty: Balanced (full Cronos mod) or VanillaNightmare (harder vanilla game, stat rework only). • WIP mode: intended for testers only.
◆ Monsters rework (currently up to Ifrit) ◄ • Enhanced AI, rewritten from the ground up. • Stat overhaul (using an improved mathematical formula). • Modified loot. • Overhaul to all in-game encounters.
◆ Systems Rework ◄ • Custom damage formula. • Junction values reworked. • Junction strength no longer based on stock, • but on minimum between character level and stock. • Overhauled magic, items, weapons, abilities, monster attacks, and more. • Reworked magic progression to be more gradual. • New magic and battle items to play with. • Limit break farming removed, no more skip turn spam! • Modified field data such as dialogue and new quests. • GF abilities overhaul. • GFs also won't heal while walking or when resting. • Complete shop rework, with new item prices. • Rebalanced refines. • SeeD salary no longer gained from moving. • New perks for SeeD rank. • Adjusted draw points. • Damage no longer capped at 9999. • Draws no longer capped at 9.
◆ Game fixes ◄ • Rare Item: Now properly increases the probability of obtaining rare items. • Uncensored Gerogero: Uses the original, uncensored Japanese version. • True Randomness: Implements a true random number generator. • Squall hit computation: Allows Squall to occasionally miss!
◆ Credits ◄ • Dangerous Dom: extensive testing. • Hobbitdur: reverse engineering, HEXT and modding tools. • Nihil: monsters and systems rework. • Malekith: damage and base monster stat formulas. • Unicorngoulash: limit break turn skip abuse fix.
◆ Special thanks ◄ • AxlRoses for the awesome preview. • Kurireddo for helping and testing. • Maki for his reverse engineering work. • myst6re for the Deling tool and reverse engineering work.
Join the team or follow the news by clicking the link! Help Hobbit continue this work by supporting him on Patreon!
